title: Land Art as a Big-Data Climate Sensor
abstract: arXiv:2609.13182v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Robert Smithson's 1970 land artwork Spiral Jetty, located in the north arm of Utah's Great Salt Lake, has alternated between submergence and exposure during severe lake decline. We analyze 1,744 co-registered Landsat 4-9 and Sentinel-2 image chips spanning every year and calendar month from 1984 to 2025. A 14-feature complexity signature combines Shannon entropy, multiscale permutation entropy, fractal dimension, lacunarity, gray-level co-occurrence texture, intensity statistics, and ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 features. These measurements are compared with a 42-year monthly climate and hydrology panel from NASA GISTEMP, USGS NWIS, Open-Meteo, and the Global Carbon Budget. Bootstrap analysis shows that Shannon entropy is a weak proxy and does not support an earlier small-sample claim of positive correlation with global temperature. By contrast, coarse-scale permutation entropy and mean intensity track lake elevation strongly, with Spear

translated_title: 大地艺术作为大数据气候传感器
translated_abstract: 罗伯特·史密森1970年创作的大地艺术作品“螺旋防波堤”位于犹他州大盐湖北支，在湖泊严重萎缩期间经历了淹没与出露的交替变化。我们分析了1,744个经过配准的Landsat 4-9和Sentinel-2图像切片，时间跨度覆盖1984年至2025年的每一年和每个日历月份。研究构建了一个由14个特征组成的复杂性特征体系，结合了香农熵、多尺度排列熵、分形维数、空隙度、灰度共生矩阵纹理、强度统计以及ImageNet预训练的ResNet50特征。这些测量结果与来自NASA GISTEMP、USGS NWIS、Open-Meteo和全球碳预算项目的42年月度气候与水文数据面板进行了比较。自助法分析表明，香农熵是一个较弱的代理指标，不支持早期小样本研究中关于其与全球温度呈正相关的论断。相比之下，粗尺度排列熵和平均强度与湖泊水位表现出强烈的追踪相关性。
tldr: 该研究开创性地将大地艺术作品“螺旋防波堤”用作大数据气候传感器，通过分析42年间1,744幅卫星图像的复杂性特征体系，发现粗尺度排列熵和平均强度是追踪大盐湖水位变化的可靠指标，同时纠正了香农熵作为全球温度代理指标的说法。
en_tdlr: This study pioneers the use of the land artwork Spiral Jetty as a big-data climate sensor, analyzing 1,744 satellite images over 42 years to show that coarse-scale permutation entropy and mean intensity reliably track Great Salt Lake elevation, while refuting Shannon entropy's alleged positive correlation with global temperature.
